attchmntText: Texmo Pipes and Products Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Texmo Pipes and Products Limited approved its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors held its meeting on November 13, 2026, at 04:00 P.M., concluding at 06:45 P.M. at the registered office. The company submitted the Un-Audited Financial Results, Statement of Assets and Liabilities, Cash Flow as at September 30, 2026, and the Limited Review Report on the Un-Audited Financial Results. This disclosure is in compliance with Regulation 30 read with Regulation 33 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The announcement was signed by Ajay Shrivastava, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Texmo Pipes and Products Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Texmo Pipes and Products Limited has intimated that its Board of Directors meeting is scheduled for Friday, 13th November, 2026, at 04:00 P.M. at the registered office. The agenda includes considering and taking on record the Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September, 2026. Additionally, the company's trading window for designated persons and their immediate relatives will remain closed until 17th November, 2026, in compliance with SEBI Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015. This notice is filed pursuant to Regulation 29 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company details include ISIN INE141K01013, BSE Code 533164, and NSE Symbol TEXMOPIPES.
